objective: Test whether acquisition support, model-specific residual fit, and error-source-independent elemental composition can jointly bound quantitative phase error across preparation, instrument, institution, and reduction-implementation shifts.

factorialDesign.unitRule: Randomized starting values and repeated software runs are computational repeats and never increase the physical preparation, acquisition, or assay denominator.

blinding.coordinator: A coordinator who performs neither diffraction reduction nor elemental analysis creates random blind specimen and aliquot IDs.
blinding.commitment: Before material leaves the preparation site, publish SHA-256(canonical truth-key JSON plus a secret salt). Keep the truth key and salt offline with the coordinator.
blinding.analystVisibility: Diffraction and elemental-analysis teams see only blind IDs, handling requirements, and method parameters. They do not see target composition, weighing ledgers, the other team's outputs, or the alternative reduction.
freezeBeforeRelease: Every expected raw file and calibration/mask hash is present.
Both reduction implementations have frozen outputs and exclusion logs.
Independent assay outputs and uncertainty budgets are frozen.
The analysis environment and decision code hashes are published.
Missingness and protocol deviations are signed without composition knowledge.
blinding.release: Reveal the salt and truth-key JSON only after every freeze condition is met; verify the public commitment before joining truth to results.

reductionContract.implementationA: TOPAS Rietveld reduction whose model family is frozen from the RC18 lineage.
reductionContract.implementationB: A separately maintained implementation using an independent codebase and analyst; a reference-pattern or direct-derivation route is preferred over a second wrapper around the same TOPAS model.

independentTruthContract.gravimetricTruth: Calibrated balance readings, purity and moisture corrections, transfer losses, and weighing uncertainty are recorded before aliquoting.
independentTruthContract.elementalAssay: XRF or an independently validated digestion plus ICP route measures Al, Ca, Zn and relevant impurities on sibling aliquots. The assay team does not use diffraction-derived phase fractions.
independentTruthContract.massBalance: Convert elemental results to a phase-composition constraint only with a frozen stoichiometric and impurity model; report unassigned mass rather than renormalizing it away.
independentTruthContract.independenceFailure: If the assay calibration uses the same prepared mixtures as truth standards or imports diffraction fractions, it cannot adjudicate diffraction accuracy.

primaryDecisions.maximumPhaseError: No accepted reduction may exceed five weight-percentage points against gravimetric truth.
primaryDecisions.unsafeAcceptance: Zero across the full blind holdout.
primaryDecisions.safeRetention: At least 0.50 of reductions that are truly within five points must be accepted.
primaryDecisions.externalTruthInclusion: At least 0.90 of composition-by-preparation blocks must have an uncertainty set containing both gravimetric and compatible elemental constraints.
primaryDecisions.implementationAgreement: The two reductions must agree in error direction and differ by no more than their frozen combined uncertainty; otherwise the block is unresolved, not averaged.
primaryDecisions.varianceIdentification: Preparation, institution/instrument, and reduction components must each be estimable from the crossed design; missing cells stop component claims.

secondaryDecisions.rc18RawRwpThreshold: Evaluate Rwp < 8.043046005815 unchanged as a transport test; failure does not authorize post-hoc rescaling.
secondaryDecisions.rawSupportGate: Evaluate the RC19 raw phase-support threshold unchanged and report its composition dependence.
secondaryDecisions.nominalAcquisitionGate: Evaluate step <= 0.04 degrees, HAL >= 70 degrees, and target maximum >= 20,000 counts as a fixed acquisition rule.
secondaryDecisions.futureNormalization: If raw Rwp does not transport between instruments, a new cycle may compare predeclared Rwp/Rexp or instrument-calibrated residuals using only a newly designated development block.

stopConditions: Any truth-key or weighing-ledger disclosure before output freeze.
Any missing preparation, institution, implementation, or assay cell that destroys the crossed variance decomposition.
A raw frame, calibration, mask, code, environment, or output without a verifiable hash.
Safe retention below 0.50 or external-truth inclusion below 0.90.
Unresolved mass exceeding the frozen impurity and transfer-loss budget.
A result that depends on exclusions or model changes made after truth release.
safetyAndEnvironment: Handle Al2O3, ZnO and CaF2 powders in a ventilated enclosure with respiratory, eye and skin protection appropriate to the local safety data sheets; prevent inhalation and uncontrolled dust release.
Use interlocked X-ray instrumentation under institutional radiation procedures; no interlock bypass is part of the protocol.
Minimize prepared mass, retain spill and waste records, and dispose of fluoride-containing material through the institution's hazardous-waste route.
No human or animal subjects and no security-sensitive synthesis are involved.
advanceRule: Qualify the stable-mixture rung only after all primary decisions pass on the blinded crossed holdout and the commitment, lineage, independent assay, and variance-decomposition audits pass. Composition transfer in the historical single-instrument dataset alone is insufficient.

nextBranchOnFailure.acquisitionGateFails: Increase information selectively at the weakest phase window or change geometry; do not increase every scan uniformly.
nextBranchOnFailure.reductionsDisagree: Localize disagreement to background, peak shape, structure, microabsorption, or exclusion decisions with sealed ablations.
nextBranchOnFailure.elementalAndGravimetricTruthDisagree: Suspend diffraction adjudication and audit purity, moisture, transfer loss, digestion, matrix correction, and unassigned mass.
nextBranchOnFailure.rwpDoesNotTransport: Reject universal raw Rwp and test a predeclared instrument-normalized residual on a new development block.
nextBranchOnFailure.allPrimaryGatesPass: Move to a VO2-specific transfer rung with texture, thermal history, and cross-probe structural/electronic separation treated as new factors.
